note: Draft from SDK files and read-only reads on probe AL130001, 2026-10-14. Not wired into the page. Fields follow site/flash/bench/board.json.

usb.note: same XDS110 CMSIS-DAP interface; product ID not re-read here

identity.note: prototype silicon (XAM13E23019): TRACEID and USERID read 0, so only the DEVICEID low half separates it from a blank read. Production parts will read different values; re-read before relying on this. Also read SRAMFLASH at 0x60111074 = 0x00802200 and ROM_SRAMFLASH at 0x6011101C = 0x00202200

flash.controllerAddress: CMDADDR is the bus address; bank 1 starts at 0x40000
flash.usedByShippedImage: TI's gpio_toggle_output left by our earlier runs; the last sector reads 0xFF

semaphore.rule: request before any flash register is readable or writable; release after

protectAtRest.note: all read 0 without the semaphore. Clear status does NOT re-protect; the proof wrote the at-rest values back by hand

gpio.note: DOE and DOUT both read 0x20 with TI's program running

reset.boot: RESETLEVEL=1 then RESETCMD=0xE4000001 (same header layout as MSPM0; names only checked in hw_sysctl.h)

cache.register: none found in the SDK headers
cache.note: readback after a write matched without turning anything off

hardwareResults.save: 524,288 bytes read twice, sha256 2974022cd52a34da017be66a7a558dd1aca36f9eb5db74a25d89fb69fe726d7a both times
hardwareResults.proof: sector 0x7F800 (last 2 KB of bank 1, blank before): erased, 128 words of a pattern programmed, read back with 0 mismatches, erased again; flash afterwards byte for byte equal to the first save. Write protection put back by hand
